title: Queen's Net
description: Use the queen to shrink the king's box, bring your king up, then mate.

title: Box Him In
description: Confine the king to the edge with the queen and march your king to support the mate.

title: The Long Walk
description: A pure rook-and-king mate. Take the opposition and drive the king to the rim.

title: Cornered Queen
description: The king hides in the corner. Beware stalemate — give it room, then close the net.

title: Rook in the Corner
description: Coordinate rook and king to deliver checkmate against the cornered king in three.
